supports.quote: I want a way to keep track of the books I've read this year. I usually forget what I read by december. it would be nice to see them all in one place with a short note on what I thought of each one. nothing fancy.

framings.text: A simple, non-fancy place to remember every book read this year and capture a short note about what you thought of each one, so they are not forgotten by December.

board.outcome: By December, see all the books read this year together in one place, each with a short note about what you thought of it.

questions.text: Should it track only books read this year, with a short note for each?
